locations.name: Materials Yard
locations.apprentice: Gain 3 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood.
locations.apprenticeZh: 获得3个资源，可任意分配为陶土与柴薪。
locations.shifu: Gain 4 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood, then exchange Clay and Wood with the supply 1:1 any number of times.
locations.shifuZh: 获得4个资源，可任意分配为陶土与柴薪；随后可与供应区任意次数按1:1兑换陶土与柴薪。

locations.name: Forming Studio
locations.apprentice: Pay the normal Clay cost to shape 1 vessel of any Shape.
locations.apprenticeZh: 支付该器型的正常陶土费用，塑形1件任意器型。
locations.shifu: Shape up to 2 vessels; each Vase or Censer costs 1 Clay during this action.
locations.shifuZh: 制作至多2件坯体；本次行动中的瓶或炉各只需1陶土。

locations.name: Glaze Workshop
locations.apprentice: Apply 1 Glaze and choose 1 Decoration for 1 shaped ceramic. Pay the Decoration cost normally.
locations.apprenticeZh: 为1件成坯器物选择1种釉色与1种装饰，并支付该装饰费用。
locations.shifu: Apply Glaze and Decoration to up to 2 shaped ceramics and ignore the Coin cost of one selected Decoration.
locations.shifuZh: 为至多2件成坯器物施釉并加装饰，且其中一项装饰免费。

locations.name: Kiln Yard
locations.apprentice: Load 1 glazed ceramic into an empty active kiln space and gain 1 Wood.
locations.apprenticeZh: 将1件施釉器物装入任一空的启用窑位，并获得1柴薪。
locations.shifu: Load up to 2 glazed ceramics, gain 1 Wood per ceramic loaded, then receive the pre-Fire reposition opportunity.
locations.shifuZh: 装入至多2件施釉器物，每件获得1柴薪；基础火候确定后可移窑。
clarifications: Gain 1 Wood per ceramic actually loaded.
At least 1 eligible ceramic must be loaded.
After Base Heat is determined and before Fire is revealed, an eligible Shifu may reposition one owned loaded ceramic.

locations.name: Market & Imperial Office
locations.apprentice: Choose one: take 1 face-up or blind-top Market or Imperial Order; or gain 2 Coins. After a normal main action, you may sell 1 Flawed ceramic for 1 Coin.
locations.apprenticeZh: 二选一：拿取1张订单（明牌或从任一牌堆顶盲抽），或获得2铜钱。正常主行动后，可出售至多1件次品，获得1铜钱。
locations.shifu: Choose one: take up to 2 face-up or blind-top Orders; take 1 Order and gain 2 Coins; gain 4 Coins; or use eligible Court Patronage. After a normal main action, you may sell up to 2 Flawed ceramics for 1 Coin each.
locations.shifuZh: 四选一：拿取至多2张订单；拿1张订单并获得2铜钱；获得4铜钱；或在符合条件时执行朝廷恩荫。正常主行动后，可出售至多2件次品，每件获得1铜钱。
locations.clarification: Court Patronage requires a completed Imperial Order, costs 5 Coins, advances Progress by 1 only from spaces 0-3, and grants neither Colour Samples nor a Flawed sale.

locations.name: Guild & Academy
locations.apprentice: Pay the printed Coin cost and acquire 1 face-up Technique.
locations.apprenticeZh: 支付印刷费用，拿取1张正面朝上的技术。
locations.shifu: Before choosing, you may place 1 face-up Technique on the bottom of its discipline deck and reveal a replacement. Then acquire 1 face-up Technique for 1 Coin less than its printed cost, minimum 0 Coins.
locations.shifuZh: 选择前可将1张明置工艺牌置于其所属牌堆底并揭示替补；随后以印刷费用减1铜钱（最低0）取得1张明置工艺牌。
